newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU details bands for ERM-II currencies.
newsitem.headline: EU details bands for ERM-II currencies.

text.p: EU finance ministers confirmed on Saturday that a new Exchange Rate Mechanism to be set up after the launch of the euro would have standard 15 percent fluctuation bands with narrower bands on a case by case basis.
European Monetary Affairs Commissioner Yves Thibault de Silguy told reporters that the new mechanism, dubbed ERM-II, would link countries waiting to join the euro to the new single currency.
There will be "standard bands of 15 percent" and narrower bands on a "case by case basis", de Silguy said after an informal meeting of EU finance ministers in this Dutch coastal resort.
The narrowness of fluctuation bands for particular countries will depend on the degree to which their economies have converged with those in the euro-zone, he added.
